item.title: No positive response from India yet: Touhid
item.description: RANGPUR, Dec 5: Foreign Affairs Adviser Md Touhid Hossain on Friday said the government of India has not yet given any positive response on Bangladesh's request to extradite ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina."We want Sheikh Hasina to be sent back. She is convicted, and the highest judicial institution has sentenced her. item.title: Labour Party cuts two decades' ties with BNP

item.title: Elderly man killed in Chuadanga road crash
item.description: An elderly man was killed after being hit by a pickup van on his way to attend Juma prayers in Alamdanga upazila of Chuadanga district on Friday.The deceased was identified as Abul Kalam Azad, 60, a resident of Nagarboalia village in the upazila.According to locals, the incident occurred in front of Nagarboalia graveyard on the Hatboalia–Bhalaipur road, shortly before Juma prayers when a pickup van struck his bicycle from behind, leaving him critically injured.Later, locals rescued and rushed hi

item.title: Pakistan, Afghanistan exchange heavy fire along border
item.description: Pakistan and Afghanistan exchanged heavy fire along their border late on Friday, officials from both countries said, amid heightened tensions following failed peace talks earlier this week.There were no immediate reports of casualties.Afghan Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mujahid said Pakistani forces launched attacks in Spin Boldak district of Kandahar province. item.title: Starvation fears as more heavy rain threaten flood-ruined Indonesia
